big: You commit ₹1 crore. The fund asks for 25% within 10 days, because it found an investment. The rest comes later. And you cannot withdraw until the fund ends. Money in an AIF is committed upfront, drawn over time and locked in.

lines: Do I pay the whole ₹1 crore on day one?

No. You commit it, and the fund calls it in parts when it finds an investment. A closed-ended fund has a fixed life, and SEBI requires a minimum tenure of three years for Category I and II. Money comes back as distributions when investments are sold.
